description: u--ith change #1. Any mitigation that exists to address a NAMED threat MUST carry an explicit threat->mitigation map in the design: name the threat, its attack path, and HOW the mitigation defeats THAT path. A mitigation with no stated threat-it-defeats is a design smell ARGUS flags. Gives downstream seats a target to verify against (its absence was the origindex root cause). Touches DAEDALUS + ARGUS role files. Maps to gauntlet Stage A (design).
title: DAEDALUS threat->mitigation map in design + ARGUS design-smell flag (u--ith #1)
